verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, so a project instructions file for coding standards is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence documents such a file (an AGENTS.md-style or rules file) that the agent reads and follows. The only nearby feature is adding skills and MCP servers from the Settings Library, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.
